implementation: Actual Worker modules; real node:crypto scrypt; SQLite transaction adapter for D1; no deployed service or OAuth claim

checks.name: scrypt has independent 128-bit salts, correct parameters and constant-size keys
anonymous documents redirect; direct private assets and APIs reject access
only login and allowlisted presentation files are public
missing database or bootstrap configuration fails closed on every surface
login rejects absent/foreign Origin, oversized and malformed request bodies
unknown account and wrong password return the same generic failure
owner login creates a hash-only session and secure HttpOnly cookie
duplicate/malformed session cookies fail; authenticated login redirects home
admin mutations require both exact Origin and per-session CSRF
admin can create only ordinary users; request cannot elevate role
ordinary users cannot list/create/disable/reset accounts
no public registration and owner cannot be disabled/reset through user endpoints
expired sessions cannot access any private asset
disable revokes every session; reenabling does not restore old cookies
admin password reset revokes sessions and invalidates old password
own password change revokes all sessions and needs current password
logout rejects missing CSRF, deletes session, and invalidates replay
bootstrap is persistent across a fresh D1 wrapper and never recreates deleted owner
account and IP rate limits persist in SQLite and reserve attempts atomically
simultaneous login attempts cannot cross the account limit
password reset during verification cannot issue an obsolete-password session
storage exception never falls through to app or assets
